Swiggy does not use this access.

Before Beta helps in another app

This permission is only for Blinkit and Zepto. After you choose to start, Beta uses screen capture and AccessibilityService to read their visible screens, including text, buttons, product names, prices, cart contents, and delivery details such as your name, precise delivery location, delivery address, and locality if shown. Beta sends this screen context to its backend only to build the cart you request. Swiggy uses a separate secure connection and does not use screen access. Beta always stops before checkout and payment. It does not place orders or pay. You can stop whenever you want. Diagnostic feedback is optional.
